summary: Module 3 BUILD: Concurrency hypothesis confirmed for the race class. The canonical analytics-bucket check-then-act is structurally absent in this fork (clicks are recorded with a single atomic INSERT guarded by unique event_key + IntegrityError, and redirects are async). Deterministic repro (forced identical candidate across two concurrent creators) reproduced the same duplicate-key failure on links.code generation: second creator crashed with 'duplicate key value violates unique constraint links_code_key'. Fixed create_link to insert with retry-on-IntegrityError (no SELECT pre-check, unique constraint arbitrates). Verification: repro now shows both creators succeed with distinct codes, 72 tests pass, live redirect repro 10/10 with no constraint violations.
